verdict.rationale: Belvo documents registrable outbound webhooks: you supply a URL to receive notifications plus an optional authorization token for protected endpoints (belvo-docs-25). Webhooks fire for recurrent-link data refreshes (belvo-docs-26) and support asynchronous workflows (belvo-docs-9, belvo-docs-11), so a programmatic consumer can subscribe to events. Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog, delivery retry/signature-verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
